title: Tidebone Crossing
description: Three closed limestone vaults, each formed by two tapered limbs meeting at the crown, stand on fractured stone footings.

review.notes: Round 2, checked against the round-1 points. Fixed: the ribs now close into three arches and the free knobs are gone. Still failing or new: each arch is one smooth tube of even thickness bent over and back down, so the group reads as giant croquet hoops rather than paired ribs meeting overhead (hero, turn_200); the six footings are low-poly pyramidal cones with flat triangular facets and loose white boulders, not buttressed stone (closeup_base). Defect: the front footing has a small arched doorway with a paved path leading into it (closeup_base); remove it, nothing in the plan calls for an entrance. Material: a fine grey speckle like terrazzo or concrete covers every rib evenly, with no weathering gradient (closeup_upper). Fix: vary the rib section (thicker and flattened at the foot, tapering to the crown, with a slight twist) and let two ribs overlap at each crown; model the footings as fractured buttresses with large planes, secondary chips and soil and turf banked against them; replace the speckle with ivory limestone graded darker towards the foot, with rain streaks on the outer face. The articulated scale figure and the vr_review_hero/vr_review_base camera options added to render_sheet.py are opt-in and only used by this asset.
